title: Exponential Convergence of the Lifted Gradient Flow of the Bass Functional
abstract: arXiv:2610.40404v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: How quickly can we construct the martingale with prescribed initial and terminal laws that is closest to Brownian motion in the sense of the martingale Benamou-Brenier problem? The construction requires the initial law of an auxiliary Brownian motion. One can take this law to be the distribution of a minimizer of the lifted Bass functional. In dimension one, Backhoff, Pammer and Schachermayer proved, under additional assumptions, that the gradient flow of this functional converges exponentially to a minimizer.   We extend this result to arbitrary dimension. translated_title: Bass 泛函的提升梯度流的指数收敛性
translated_abstract: 我们能以多快的速度构造一个具有指定初始分布和终端分布的鞅，使其在鞅 Benamou-Brenier 问题的意义下最接近布朗运动？这一构造需要一个辅助布朗运动的初始分布，而该分布可以取为提升 Bass 泛函的极小化子的分布。在一维情形下，Backhoff、Pammer 和 Schachermayer 曾在附加假设下证明，该泛函的梯度流会指数收敛于一个极小化子。我们将这一结果推广到了任意维数。在本文的假设下，从一个有界随机向量出发的梯度流在 $L^2$ 中指数收敛于具有相同均值的极小化子。我们通过证明以下事实来完成这一证明：对于具有指定初始分布的固定随机向量 $X$，提升 Bass 泛函在每一个由具有指定均值及……的 $\sigma(X)$-可测向量构成的集合上都是强凸的。
tldr: 本文将提升 Bass 泛函梯度流的指数收敛结果从一维推广到任意维数，证明从有界随机向量出发的梯度流在 $L^2$ 中指数收敛于具有相同均值的极小化子。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the exponential convergence of the gradient flow of the lifted Bass functional from one dimension to arbitrary dimensions, proving that the flow starting from a bounded random vector converges exponentially in $L^2$ to the minimizer with the same mean.
